entries.question: Appointment kaise book kare
entries.answer:
KGMU mein OPD appointment book karne ke liye aap niche diye gaye tarikon ka upyog kar sakte hain:

**1. Online Appointment (Mandatory/Recommended):**
*   **ORS Portal:** [ors.gov.in](https://ors.gov.in) par login/register karein, Uttar Pradesh select karein, phir KGMU chunein aur department/date select karke appointment book karein.
*   **ABHA/Health Care App:** Apne mobile number aur OTP se register karke appointment book kar sakte hain.

**2. SMS dwara:**
*   Aap `APPOINTMENT <Patient Name>` likhkar **8887019134** par SMS bhej sakte hain.

**3. Walk-in (Counter se):**
*   Aap seedhe KGMU aakar bhi token le sakte hain. Iske liye apna Aadhaar card aur active mobile number saath layein (OTP verification ke liye).

**OPD se judi zaruri jaankari:**
*   **OPD Fee:** ₹50 (sabhi booking methods ke liye).
*   **Samay:** Somvar se Shukravar (9:00 AM – 1:00 PM) aur Shanivar (9:00 AM – 12:00 PM). Sunday ko OPD band rehti hai.
*   **Zaruri Baat:** Parchi/ticket counter dopahar 1:00 baje sharp band ho jata hai. Agar aap Lucknow se bahar ke hain, toh apne department se sambandhit **valid referral** zarur saath layein.

KGMU mein bheed se bachne ke liye pre-booking ki salah di jati hai.

*Disclaimer: Main qualified doctor nahi hoon. Agar aapko koi medical emergency hai, toh kripya turant KGMU ke Trauma Centre (Gate 14) jayein. Kripya chat mein apni personal health details ya Aadhaar number share na karein.*

entries.question: Emergency opthalmologist ko dikhana hain
entries.answer:
Agar aapko aankh se sambandhit koi emergency hai, toh kripya turant **KGMU Trauma Centre (Gate 14)** par jayein.

**Zaruri jaankari:**
*   **Emergency Access:** Trauma Centre 24/7 khula rehta hai. Ophthalmology (Aankh) ki emergency ke liye aap wahan report kar sakte hain.
*   **Gate 14:** Trauma Centre mein pravesh ke liye Gate 14 ka upyog karein.
*   **KGMU Guidelines:** KGMU mein emergency treatment ke liye pehle 24 ghante ki dawaiyan aur supplies free di jati hain.

**Salah:**
*   Main ek AI assistant hoon aur medical advice nahi de sakta. Agar sthiti gambhir hai, toh bina deri kiye turant hospital pahunchein.
*   Kripya chat mein apni personal medical details share na karein.

Aap hospital ke emergency helpline number **0522-2258880** ya **0522-3539333** par bhi sampark kar sakte hain.

entries.question: how can i get final bill after treatment
entries.answer:
To obtain your final bill after treatment at KGMU, please follow these steps:

1.  **Visit the Billing/Accounts Section:** The final bill is typically processed at the billing counter of the specific hospital or center where you were admitted (e.g., Shatabdi Hospital, Trauma Centre, or the main hospital building).
2.  **Provide Necessary Documentation:** You will need to provide your patient registration/IPD number, discharge summary, and any relevant admission papers.
3.  **Clear Outstanding Dues:** Ensure all pharmacy, diagnostic, and procedure charges are settled. Once the final clearance is done, the billing department will generate the official final bill.
4.  **Contact the PRO/Patient Welfare Office:** If you are having difficulty locating the billing counter or require assistance with the process, you may contact the **Patient Welfare Office** at the Trauma Centre (Phone: 8887019133) or the main **PRO Office** (Phone: 9415007710).

For further guidance, you can check the [PRO/CUG contact page](https://www.kgmu.org/pro_cug.php) to reach out to the administrative office responsible for your specific ward.

entries.question: Demalogist kis day me baithe hai
entries.answer:
KGMU mein Dermatology (Dermatologist) OPD ka samay:

*   **Din:** Mangalwar (Tuesday), Budhwar (Wednesday), aur Shanivar (Saturday).
*   **Room No:** 303, 304 (Third Floor).

Kripya dhyan dein ki OPD mein dikhane ke liye online registration (https://ors.gov.in) anivarya (mandatory) hai. OPD ka samay subah 9:00 baje se dopehar 1:00 baje tak hota hai.

entries.question: To kal dikhna hai mujhe mummy ko
entries.answer:
Kal (22 August 2026, Shukrawar) Dermatology (Skin) department ki OPD band hai, kyunki Dermatology OPD Mangalwar, Budhwar aur Shanivar ko chalti hai.

Agar aapki mummy ko skin se sambandhit koi emergency samasya hai, to aap **Trauma Centre (Gate 14)** par ja sakte hain, jo 24/7 khula rehta hai. 

**Kuch mahatvapurn baatein:**
*   **OPD ke liye:** Agli OPD Shanivar (22 August ke baad) ko hogi.
*   **Registration:** KGMU mein dikhane ke liye online appointment (https://ors.gov.in) lena ya OPD slip lena anivarya hai.
*   **Salah:** Main ek AI hoon, doctor nahi. Agar samasya gambhir hai, to turant emergency mein sampark karein. 

Kripya apni mummy ki medical reports ya koi bhi niji jaankari yahan share na karein, ye surakshit nahi hai.

entries.question: Hair fall ho gya almost sara
entries.answer:
Hair fall ek gambhir samasya ho sakti hai, lekin main ek AI hoon aur medical doctor nahi, isliye main aapko bimari ka nidaan (diagnosis) ya dawa nahi bata sakta. 

KGMU mein Dermatology (Skin) department is tarah ki samasyaon ke liye sahi jagah hai. Aapke liye kuch mahatvapurn salah:

1.  **Doctor se paramarsh lein:** Hair fall ke kai karan ho sakte hain (jaise ki poshan ki kami, hormonal imbalance, ya koi anya bimari). Sahi ilaj ke liye Dermatology department mein doctor ko dikhana hi sabse behtar hai.
2.  **OPD ka samay:** Dermatology OPD **Mangalwar, Budhwar, aur Shanivar** ko chalti hai. Aap Shanivar (22 August) ko subah 9:00 baje se pehle pahunch kar apna registration karwa sakte hain.
3.  **Online Appointment:** KGMU mein dikhane ke liye online registration (https://ors.gov.in) karna anivarya hai. Aap wahan se appointment lekar aayen taaki aapko wait na karna pade.
4.  **Suraksha:** Apni ya apni mummy ki koi bhi niji medical reports, Aadhaar number, ya phone number is chat mein share na karein.

Aap Shanivar ko OPD mein jakar doctor se mil sakte hain. Tab tak ke liye, kisi bhi tarah ke gharelu nuskhe ya bina doctor ki salah ke koi dawa istemal karne se bachein.

entries.question: cardiology department opd
entries.answer:
The Cardiology department (LARI Cardiology) provides outpatient services at KGMU. Please note the following important information:

*   **Online Registration:** Online registration is mandatory for all OPD visits. You can book your appointment via the [Online Registration System (ORS)](https://ors.gov.in) or the ABHA/Health Care App.
*   **OPD Timings:** Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–1:00 PM; Saturday, 9:00 AM–12:00 PM (Closed on Sundays).
*   **OPD Slip Fee:** ₹50 (payable through all booking methods).
*   **Referral Requirement:** Patients from outside Lucknow must bring a valid referral for the Cardiology department.
*   **Emergency:** If you have a cardiac emergency, please go directly to the **Trauma Centre** (Gate 14) for stabilization; patients are then transferred to the LARI Cardiology department as needed.
*   **Contact:** For inquiries, you may contact the PRO Office at LARI Cardiology at **9415099528**.

For more detailed information, you can visit the department page: [Cardiology Department](https://www.kgmu.org/department_details.php?dept_id=9&dept_type=2).

entries.question: Appointment
entries.answer:
To book an appointment at KGMU, you can use any of the following methods:

*   **Online (Recommended):** Register and book through the **[Online Registration System (ORS)](https://ors.gov.in)**.
*   **ABHA/Health Care App:** Register using your mobile number and OTP, then select KGMU to book your slot.
*   **SMS:** Send `APPOINTMENT <Patient Name>` to **8887019134**.
*   **Walk-in:** Visit the hospital with your Aadhaar card and an active mobile number. You will receive an OTP, pay the ₹50 fee, and collect a physical token/OPD slip.

**Important Information:**
*   **OPD Timings:** Monday–Friday: 9:00 AM–1:00 PM; Saturday: 9:00 AM–12:00 PM (Closed on Sundays).
*   **Fees:** The OPD slip fee is ₹50 for all booking methods.
*   **Referrals:** Patients from outside Lucknow must bring a valid referral for the specific department.
*   **Arrival:** The ticket/parchi counter closes at 1:00 PM sharp. Pre-booking is strongly recommended to avoid long wait times.

*Disclaimer: I am not qualified to provide medical advice. Please consult a doctor at KGMU OPD or call the helpline at 0522-2258880 or 0522-3539333. For your safety, please avoid sharing personal details like Aadhaar or phone numbers in this chat.*

entries.question: Appointment book karna hai
entries.answer:

**1. Online Booking (Recommended)**
*   **Website:** Visit [https://ors.gov.in](https://ors.gov.in)
*   **Process:** Login/register → Select Uttar Pradesh → Select KGMU → Choose Department/Date/Time → Fill patient details → Pay ₹50 fee → Download the slip.
*   **App:** You can also use the ABHA/Health Care app by following the same selection flow.

**2. SMS Booking**
*   Send an SMS in the format: `APPOINTMENT <PATIENT NAME>` to **8887019134**.

**3. Walk-in Registration**
*   Visit the hospital with your **Aadhaar card** and an **active mobile number**.
*   You will receive an OTP for verification.
*   After paying the ₹50 fee, you will receive a physical token and your OPD slip.

**Important Notes:**
*   **OPD Timings:** Monday–Friday (9:00 AM–1:00 PM) and Saturday (9:00 AM–12:00 PM).
*   **Closing Time:** The ticket/parchi counter closes strictly at 1:00 PM.
*   **Referral:** If you are coming from outside Lucknow, please bring a valid referral letter for the specific department.
